title: Group Code for VS Code — Navigate by Functionality | 85-Second Demo
description:
Find related code by functionality across files and languages with Group Code for Visual Studio Code.

This 85-second walkthrough shows adding @group annotations, browsing the functionality hierarchy, jumping directly to TypeScript/SQL/HTML source entries, searching, favorites, hierarchy renaming, the Copilot suggestion command, and automatic index updates.

Get the extension:
https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=thechandanbhagat.groupcode

Source code and documentation:
https://github.com/thechandanbhagat/group-code

Chapters
0:00 Meet Group Code
0:12 Add annotations and a hierarchy
0:27 Browse related source files
0:40 Navigation, search, favorites and rename
0:58 Copilot suggestion workflow
1:08 Live updates and closing

Captured from the real VS Code extension in an isolated sample project. The Copilot segment shows the suggestion command; live suggestions require an available GitHub Copilot model.

English narration and captions, with original instrumental background music kept quiet beneath speech.
